vibe_rationale: Young lakeside wellness festival with yoga, music and camping; on-brand in tone but not yet a recognised scene.
fit_notes: Mostly adult wellness crowd camping by the lake, with yoga, sound healing and breathwork at the centre of the programme; community depth is still young. Three partners and a venue, with a partnership page and contact email. A direct fit for a sampling or workshop slot, but a US partner would be needed to activate.
